subject: Is there an option to show taxa name/tip label with spaces, and possibly selectively format them?

messages.author: 0636c591dc0d6576
messages.subject: Is there an option to show taxa name/tip label with spaces, and possibly selectively format them?
parts:
Hi ,

Is there an option in ggtree to show the taxa name with spaces? I replaced underscore with spaces in tree object tip.label, but when plotted with ggtree, it didnt show tip labels. Also, is there a way to selectively format tip labels? For example, italicizing genus and species name, but not the strain name (Acetobacter pasteurianus IFO 3283-01-42C to Acetobacter pasteurianus IFO 3283-01-42C).

Thank you

messages.author: f0dc0fdb872722c6
messages.subject: Re: Is there an option to show taxa name/tip label with spaces, and possibly selectively format them?
parts:
taxa name with spaces is of course supported.

formatting label is also possible by using plotmath.
